answer: A bond of 15% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in atlas, and violet reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 51 aliases, and each one needs its own funded pulse account. A farm of 538 identities would post 2902 proofs and burn roughly 62 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
